questions.q: What does Acuff say happens when you quit your day job too soon?
a: You trade one boss for many bills and strain relationships
You gain instant creative freedom and energy
You lose all chance of ever writing a book
You confuse your family but impress employers
questions.why: Lesson 1 warns that bills become new bosses and money worry damages your closest relationships.

questions.q: Why does the summary recommend hustling in the morning?
a: Early progress changes how you feel all day
Publishers and clients answer only at dawn
Night work is impossible for most people
Your energy peaks only before sunrise
questions.why: Lesson 2 says finishing work before breakfast makes you walk into your job feeling confident.

questions.q: What should you define before you reach success?
a: What enough means to you
How famous you want to be
Which rival you want to beat
How much you will sacrifice
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to spell out what enough means, or you will hustle past it and never feel satisfied.

questions.q: How does Acuff remind himself of his definition of enough?
a: He schedules an email to his future self
He writes it on his office wall
He tells his boss every quarter
He keeps a daily progress chart
questions.why: Lesson 3 describes an email sent a year later, recalling that family and a good job were enough.

questions.q: What two problems does the summary link to quitting early?
a: Many small bosses and damaged relationships
Lost savings and a ruined reputation
Boredom and a lack of structure
Legal trouble and missed deadlines
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists replacement bosses in the form of bills, plus serious strain on your relationships.
